post.text:
Waco Police Arrest Texas Father Over Viral Ring Doorbell Camera Footage

Paul Thames, 29, was arrested and charged after turning himself in to Waco police following the viral video.

In the footage, Thames is seen with his 3-year-old son at the Legend Apartments. 

The footage https://t.co/qn7iytf1tS
post.author_description: Kinda Like Cops in the 90’s l Crime l Bodycam Enthusiast l Police Activity l Follow to Stay Informed

description.description: This video clip captures a distressing scene where a man appears to be kidnapping a small child. The footage, likely from a security camera, shows the man emerging from a stairwell, carrying the child who seems to be struggling. A mugshot of a man, presumably the suspect, is superimposed on the left side of the frame. The video highlights a serious criminal act, emphasizing the importance of surveillance in identifying and apprehending individuals involved in such incidents. The presence of the mugshot suggests that the person has been identified and potentially arrested for this crime.
